description: Get one saved Radar report: its name, subjects, period, sources and presentation settings, and its Radar link. The report's mentions and news are read on its Radar page, not returned here; to answer from the data, use the podcast tools on the same subjects.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

report_id.description: Report id from particle_report_list or particle_report_create.

name: particle_report_get
title: Particle Report Get
